symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of data bits the array holds.
symbols.quote: $V$ is the stored bit volume, the number of data bits the array holds.

symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in one field.
symbols.quote: $u$ is the width of each field, the number of address bits in one field; the letter $u$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: width exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent with 0 < tau < 1 in the cost bound O(V u^tau).

symbols.name: matrix size
symbols.meaning: The size of the network's matrices; each field splits into d pieces.
symbols.quote: Let $d\ge2$ be the size of the network's matrices; a field splits into $d$ pieces of width $u/d$.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network, scratch wires included.
symbols.quote: Its $W$ wires, scratch wires included, each carry rows of volume $V/W$.

symbols.name: network edge
symbols.meaning: An edge of the linear network, running from its tail to its head.
symbols.quote: Each edge $e$ changes that shear by $G_e$, the difference of its end-vertex matrices, by the interchanges above.

symbols.name: edge matrix difference
symbols.meaning: The difference of the matrices at the two ends of the edge e, which changes the shear.
symbols.quote: Each edge $e$ changes that shear by $G_e$, the difference of its end-vertex matrices, by the interchanges above.

symbols.name: calls per level
symbols.meaning: The number of interchange calls made in one level, summed over the edges.
symbols.quote: Summing over edges, one level makes $R=\sum_e\operatorname{rank}G_e$ calls, each on volume $V/W$ and width $u/d$.

symbols.name: time per bit
symbols.meaning: The time per stored bit of an array of field width u.
symbols.quote: Let $\varphi(u)$ be the time per stored bit at width $u$.

symbols.name: level constant
symbols.meaning: A constant bounding the work of one level, per stored bit.
symbols.quote: Each level's own work is $CV$ for a constant $C$, so dividing by $V$ gives $\varphi(u)\le\gamma\varphi(u/d)+C$, with $\gamma=R/W$.

symbols.name: cost ratio
symbols.meaning: The ratio R/W of the calls per level to the wires, which multiplies the cost of the recursion.
symbols.quote: Each level's own work is $CV$ for a constant $C$, so dividing by $V$ gives $\varphi(u)\le\gamma\varphi(u/d)+C$, with $\gamma=R/W$.

symbols.name: number of levels
symbols.meaning: The number of levels of the recursion needed to reach width 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\ell=\log_d u$ be the number of levels; $\ell$ levels reach width 1, where a single-digit swap gives $\varphi(1)=O(1)$.

relations.quote: The procedure is applied to each [Address shear](address-shear.md) that a layer (one stage of the transform) produces.
The shear is realized by running the [Linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), whose gates act pointwise on the array.
